topic: Practical on identifying various components and analyzing of Wiring diagram manual.
syllabus_extract: Practical on identifying various components and analyzing of Wiring diagram manual.
specific_objectives: 21.1.10.1 Trainee will be able to explain how to carry out DI / DR on aircraft system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of components on wiring diagram; verification of circuit paths; safety precautions regarding electrical isolation; instructor supervision during diagram analysis.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a wiring diagram manual?
List three common symbols found in aircraft electrical schematics.
Why is it critical to verify power isolation before analyzing a circuit?

topics: Tracing circuit paths from power source
Understanding circuit breaker and fuse ratings
development.content:
Identification of standard electrical symbols
Interpretation of wire color codes
Tracing circuit paths from power source
Locating component reference designations
Understanding circuit breaker and fuse ratings

topics: Verification of ground and power points
Identification of switch positions and functions
development.content:
Analysis of component interconnections
Verification of ground and power points
Identification of switch positions and functions
Review of circuit protection devices
Cross-referencing with system logic

Execution of DI/DR procedures
Documentation of findings
Troubleshooting common diagram errors
Safety checks during analysis
Final review of circuit integrity

summary_questions: Explain the step-by-step process for performing a DI/DR on an aircraft system.
How do you verify that a circuit is correctly grounded according to the diagram?
What safety precautions must be taken before analyzing a live or potentially live circuit?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report identifying five key components in the next system's wiring diagram and explain their function, bridging the knowledge required for LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Identification / removal and installation of various system components.
